content: Dawiti Yihuda Bolla Kawotis
Hessafe guye, Dawiti, “Yihuda katamatape issuwa boo?” yaagidi Godaa oychis. Goday, “Ee, ba” yaagis. Dawiti, “Awu boo” yaagidi oychis. Goday, “Kebroona ba” yaagidi zaaris.
Dawiti ba nam7u macheta, Izira7eele Aknahoomanne kase Naabala machiw Qarmeloosa Abigiya ekidi Kebroona katamaa bis.
Dawiti baara de7iya asatanne enta soo asa ubbaa ehin, Kebroonaninne iya heeran de7iya katamatan de7idosona.
Yihuda asati Kebroona katamaa yidi, Dawita tiyidi Yihuda bolla kawothidosona. Dawiti Yaabesa Galada asay Saa7ola moogidaysa si7ida wode,
I ase kiittidi, “Hinte hinte godaa Saa7ola moogida gisho he keehatethas Goday hintena anjo.
Goday siiquwanne tumatethaa hintew qonciso; taanika ha keehatetha gisho hintew lo77o kushe zaarana.
Hiza minnite; xaalite; hinte goday Saa7oli hayqis. Yihuda asay tana tiyidi, banta bolla kawothidosona” yaagis.
Nam7u Keethata Giddon De7iya Ola
Saa7ola tora moconay Neera na7ay Abeneeri Saa7ola na7aa Iyabuste ekidi, Mahinayma geetetiya bessaa efis.
Iya Galadan, Aseeran, Izra7eelan, Efreeman, Biniyaameninne Isra7eele biitta ubban kawothis.
Saa7ola na7ay, Iyabustey Isra7eele bolla kawotiya wode iyaw oytamu laythi; I nam7u laythi kawotis. Gidoshin, Yihuda asay Dawita kaallidosona.
Dawiti Kebroonan Yihuda bolla laapun laythinne bagga kawotis.
Neera na7ay Abeneerinne Saa7ola na7ay Iyabuste asay Mahinaymape Gaba7oona bidosona.
Xaruya na7ay Iyo7aabinne Dawita asay Gaba7oona olla haatha matan entara gahetidosona. Issi cugay olla haathaafe hefinthan uttin, issi cugay hafinthan uttis.
Abeneeri Iyo7aabako, “Ane hintefenne nuupe panthati dendidi, nu sinthan oleto” yaagis. Iyo7aabi, “Ero, dendidi oleto” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Biniyaamepe Saa7ola na7aa Iyabustes tammanne nam7u asati keyidi, Dawitas eqida tammanne nam7u asatara ola gahetidosona.
Issoy issoy ba morkiya huuphiya oykidi, mashshan miyen caddis; hessada hannidi laatamanne oydday hayqidosona. Hessa gisho Gaba7oonan de7iya he bessay Mashsha biitta geetetis.
He gallas wolqaama ola oletidi, Dawita asay Abeneeranne Isra7eele asaa xoonis.
Xaruya nayti heedzay Iyo7aabi, Abisinne Asaheeli he bessan de7oosona; Asaheeli woshi7eda eeson woxidi,
Asaheeli Abeneera ushachi woyko haddirsi goonna yedethis.
Abeneeri guye simmidi, “Asaheela, nenee?” yaagidi oychis. Asaheeli, “Ee tana” yaagis.
Abeneeri, “Ushachi woyko haddirsi simmada, asatape issuwa oykada iya ola miishiya eka” yaagis. Shin Asaheeli iya yedetheysa aggonna ixis.
Qassika Abeneeri, “Taani nena sa7ara gathada oythonna de7ishin, tana yedetheysa agga! Nena wodhada taani ne ishaa Iyo7aaba som7uwa waatada xeellanee?” yaagidi waassis.

Shin Asaheeli iya yedetheysa aggonna ixis. Hessa gisho, Abeneeri toora guye yeddidi, Asaheela uluwa caddin tooray zokora kanthidi keyis. Asaheeli he bessan kundidi hayqis; Asaheeli hayqida bessaa gakida asa ubbay yan eqis.
Shin Iyo7aabinne Abisi Abeneera gooddidosona; awi wulliya wode Gaba7oona mela biittako efiya ogiyan Gaadape sintha baggara de7iya Ama zumako gakidosona.
Biniyaame asay Abeneerako shiiqidosona; issi cuga medhidi issi zumaa bolla eqidosona.
Abeneeri Iyo7aaba xeegidi, “Merinaw oletishe daaneyee? Haysa wursethay camo gidanaysa neeni erikii? Ne asay, banta ishata gooddeysa aggana mela ayis odikii?” yaagis.
Iyo7aabi, “De7o Xoossay ero! Neeni odonnaba gidiyako ta asay ba ishata sa7i wontana gakanaw goodda aggokona” yaagis.
Iyo7aabi moyze punnin asa ubbay essis. Isra7eeleta zaari goodibookona woyko olibookona.
Abeneerinne iya asay he qamma kumethi hemetidi Araba gadha gakidosona. Yordaanose shaafa pinnidi, Betroona kanthidi Mahinayme yidosona.
Iyo7aabi Abeneera gooddeysa aggidi, ba asa ubbaa issi bessi shiishidi xeelliya wode, Asaheela gujonna Dawita asaape tammanne uddufun asi pacis.
Shin Dawita asay Abeneerara de7iya Biniyaame kochatape heedzu xeetanne usupun tammu asi wodhidosona.
Asaheela aha ekidi, Beeteleme kataman de7iya iya aawa duufon moogidosona. Iyo7aabinne iya asay qamma kumethi hemetidi sa7i wontiya wode Kebroona gakidosona.
